transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you into the clinic today?

I’m here because I’ve started arranging my whole house around not having to see spiders. I put off doing laundry because it’s in the basement, I avoid the garden shed, and I pay people to do little jobs I could easily do myself just so I don’t have to go into those spaces.
Is this intense fear and avoidance focused solely on spiders?

Yes, it’s spiders. I know, logically, that one in the corner of an old house probably won’t hurt me, but if I picture one dropping out of a box or sitting near the washer, it feels huge and threatening. I’m embarrassed by how strong the reaction is.
